Two products, one ecosystem

Mira
Your school.
Perfectly organized.

Mira is the all-in-one workspace built for educational institutions. Manage attendance, share resources, host virtual meetings, organize timetables and keep every stakeholder on the same page — all from one dashboard.

📊 Attendance 📄 PDF Uploads 🎥 Meetings 📅 Scheduling 📢 Announcements
KnowNext
Every question
finds an answer.

KnowNext is the learning community where students post their doubts and peers or teachers step in to help. Build shared knowledge, celebrate problem-solvers, and ensure no student is ever stuck alone.

💬 Ask Anything 🏆 Top Helpers 📂 Share Resources 🔔 Follow Topics 👨‍🏫 Teacher Verified

Everything Mira
handles for you

Tools designed for teachers, administrators and institutions to run smoothly every day.

📊
Attendance Management

Mark, track and export daily attendance for students. Get alerts for absentees and auto-generate monthly reports.

📄
PDF Upload & Sharing

Upload notes, assignments and syllabi as PDFs. Share instantly with specific batches, classes or individuals.

🎥
Host Meetings

Schedule and run virtual meetings directly inside Mira — parent-teacher meets, staff reviews or live classes.

📅
Timetable & Scheduling

Create and publish class schedules, exam dates and events. Students and teachers always know what's next.

📢
Announcements

Broadcast notices to the whole school or specific batches. Urgent alerts, holiday notices and reminders in one tap.

📈
Reports & Analytics

Get a bird's-eye view of attendance trends, resource usage and engagement — all in one clean dashboard.

Learn together on
KnowNext

A peer-powered community where curiosity meets collaboration.

🙋
Post Your Doubts

Any student can ask any question — from tricky math problems to career advice — and get real answers fast.

👨‍🏫
Teacher-Verified Answers

Teachers can mark the best answers as verified, so students always know which solution to trust.

🤝
Peer-to-Peer Help

Smart students help others and earn recognition. The more you give, the higher you rise on the leaderboard.

📂
Share Resources

Attach PDFs, images and links to answers. Build a growing library of knowledge the whole class benefits from.

🔔
Follow Topics & Tags

Subscribe to subjects or topics. Get notified when new questions or answers appear in your areas of interest.

🏆
Recognition & Badges

Top contributors earn badges and are highlighted to the community — rewarding those who help others learn.
